08 — Installing

Three commands

# from the folder you downloaded
./sync-to-repo.sh ~/code/meridian-bank-v2

# then, in the repo
git add public/images
git commit -m "Add photography for landing and marketing pages"
git push

The script only copies files into public/images/ — it never touches your source. SNIPPETS.md has the exact JSX to paste into src/app/page.tsx and the openGraph block for src/app/layout.tsx.
